Urban Edge

Architecture Beyond Expectations.

Bauchi, Nigeria

Designed Around Experience.

Urban Edge brings a composed, contemporary address to Bauchi: stone, timber and glass arranged around landscaped courtyards and open lawns.

Sun-warmed surfaces, shaded planting and generous setbacks give each block room to breathe. Grounded, calm and quietly confident.
